class="white-line"></section><section class="section carousel row" id="WhyUnrealSection"><div class="title text-center"><h4>Proven Powerful Technology</h4></div><div class="slick-initialized slick-slider" id="whyUnreal"><div class="slick-arrow slick-prev" data-role="none" style="display:block"><div class="slick-control" role="button"><i class="icon-arrow"></i></div></div><div class="slick-list" style="height: 816px;"><div class="slick-track" style="opacity: 1; transform: translate3d(-770px, 0px, 0px); width: 4620px;"><div class="slick-slide slick-cloned" data-index="-1" style="width: 770px;"><div class="slide"><div class="bk-img" style='background-image: url("https://cdn2.unrealengine.com/Unreal+Engine%2FueOverview%2FwhyUE%2FUE_AboutPage_Slider_WEB_FORTNITE_1-1792x836-849ecc5b899c9f255c8a0484a87302b79e6944d1.jpg");'><div class="gradient-overlay"></div></div><div class="section-container row"><div class="col-md-6 col-lg-5 text-light content"><h2>Made by developers,<span><br/> <!-- -->for developers</span></h2><div><p>At Epic, we use the engine ourselves to craft award-winning content resulting in powerful tools and pipelines that enable you to achieve your goals. Over the course of two decades, Unreal has become the most trusted, reliable engine in the world.</p>
</div></div></div><div class="pull-right caption"><p>Fortnite</p><p>Epic Games</p></div></div></div><div class="slick-slide slick-active" data-index="0" style="outline: none; width: 770px;" tabindex="-1"><div class="slide"><div class="bk-img" style='background-image: url("https://cdn2.unrealengine.com/Unreal+Engine%2FueOverview%2FwhyUE%2FUE_AboutPage_Slider_WEB_Injustice2-1792x836-b149ae3ea05c88542d1b6c38073e451d45c8be0a.jpg");'><div class="gradient-overlay"></div></div><div class="section-container row"><div class="col-md-6 col-lg-5 text-light content"><h2>Uncompromised quality,<span><br/> <!-- -->proven results</span></h2><div><p>Unreal Engine is a complete suite of creation tools designed to meet ambitious artistic visions while being flexible enough to ensure success for teams of all sizes. As an established, industry-leading engine, Unreal delivers powerful, proven performance that you can trust.</p>

</div></div></div><div class="pull-right caption"><p>Sea of Thieves</p><p>Rare</p></div></div></div><div class="slick-slide" data-index="3" style="outline: none; width: 770px;" tabindex="-1"><div class="slide"><div class="bk-img" style='background-image: url("https://cdn2.unrealengine.com/Unreal+Engine%2FueOverview%2FwhyUE%2FUE_AboutPage_Slider_WEB_FORTNITE_1-1792x836-849ecc5b899c9f255c8a0484a87302b79e6944d1.jpg");'><div class="gradient-overlay"></div></div><div class="section-container row"><div class="col-md-6 col-lg-5 text-light content"><h2>Made by developers,<span><br/> <!-- -->for developers</span></h2><div><p>At Epic, we use the engine ourselves to craft award-winning content resulting in powerful tools and pipelines that enable you to achieve your goals. As an established, industry-leading engine, Unreal delivers powerful, proven performance that you can trust.</p>
</div></div></div><div class="pull-right caption"><p>Injustice 2</p><p>NetherRealm Studios</p></div></div></div></div></div><div class="slick-arrow slick-next" data-role="none" style="display:block"><div class="slick-control" role="button"><i class="icon-arrow"></i></div></div><ul class="carousel-dots bottom" style="display: block;"><li class="slick-active"><button>1</button></li><li class=""><button>2</button></li><li class=""><button>3</button></li><li class=""><button>4</button></li></ul></div></section><section class="section carousel row" id="featuresSection"><div class="title invert text-center"><h4>Everything is included</h4></div><div class="slick-initialized slick-slider" id="features"><div class="slick-arrow slick-prev" data-role="none" style="display:block"><div class="slick-control" role="button"><i class="icon-arrow"></i></div></div><div class="slick-list" style="height: 560px;"><div class="slick-track" style="opacity: 1; transform: translate3d(-770px, 0px, 0px); width: 6930px;"><div class="slick-slide slick-cloned" data-index="-1" style="width: 770px;"><div class="slide"><div class="lazyload-placeholder"></div><div class="section-container row"><div><div class="col-md-6 col-md-offset-6"><div class="content text-light"><h2 class="">Asset Marketplace</h2><div> The ever-expanding Unreal Engine Marketplace has thousands of high-quality assets to start or accelerate your project including Blueprints, plugins, effects, textures, animations, meshes, audio, and project starter kits. Or, create your own content and sell directly to others. </div></div></div></div></div><div class="pull-right caption"><p></p><p></p></div></div></div><div class="slick-slide slick-active" data-index="0" style="outline: none; width: 770px;" tabindex="-1"><div class="slide"><div class="lazyload-placeholder"></div><div class="section-container row"><div><div class="col-md-6 col-md-offset-6"><div class="content"><h2 class="big">Everything is included<span><br/>to build and ship</span></h2><div><p>The Unreal Engine is a full product suite that comes production ready out of the box without the need for additional plugins or purchases.</p>
</div></div></div></div></div><div class="pull-right caption"><p></p><p></p></div></div></div><div class="slick-slide" data-index="1" style="outline: none; width: 770px;" tabindex="-1"><div class="slide"><div class="lazyload-placeholder"></div><div class="section-container row"><div><div class="col-md-6 col-lg-5"><div class="content first text-light"><h2 class="">Blueprints:<span><br/>create without coding</span></h2><div><p>With Blueprints, you can rapidly prototype and ship playable interactive content without touching a line of code.</p>
</div></div></div><div class="col-md-6 col-md-offset-0 col-lg-4 col-lg-offset-3"><div class="content second text-light false"><h2>Full C++ source code included</h2><div><p>With complete C++ source code, you can study, customize and debug the entire engine, and ship your project without obstruction.</p>
</div></div></div></div></div><div class="pull-right caption"><p>Lost Ember</p><p>Mooneye Studios</p></div></div></div><div class="slick-slide" data-index="2" style="outline: none; width: 770px;" tabindex="-1"><div class="slide"><div class="lazyload-placeholder"></div><div class="section-container row"><div><div class="col-md-6 col-lg-5"><div class="content text-light"><h2 class="">Sequencer:<span><br/>professional cinematics</span></h2><div>Designed by film and TV professionals, Sequencer unlocks your creative potential with a fully non-linear, real-time cinematics and animation tool. Powerful features include dynamic cutscene variations, cinematic cameras and live gameplay recording.</div></div></div><div class="col-sm-8 col-sm-offset-2 col-md-6 col-md-offset-0"><div class="content image"><div class="lazyload-placeholder"></div></div></div></div></div><div class="pull-right caption"><p>Hellblade: Senua’s Sacrifice</p><p>Ninja Theory</p></div></div></div><div class="slick-slide" data-index="3" style="outline: none; width: 770px;" tabindex="-1"><div class="slide"><div class="lazyload-placeholder"></div><div class="section-container row"><div><div class="col-md-6 col-lg-5"><div class="content first text-light"><h2 class="">Photoreal rendering<span><br/>in real-time</span></h2><div><p>Achieve Hollywood-quality visuals out of the box. Features such as Physically Based Rendering, Advanced Dynamic Shadow Options, Screenspace Reflections and Lighting Channels equip you with the flexibility and efficiency to create awe-inspiring content.</p>
</div></div></div><div class="col-md-6 col-md-offset-0 col-lg-4 col-lg-offset-3"><div class="content second text-light false"><h2>VFX quality particle systems</h2><div>Completely customize particle systems using a wide variety of modules, leverage particle lights to impact your scene and build complex particle motion with vector fields to mimic reality and create professional levels of polish.</div></div></div></div></div><div class="pull-right caption"><p>Paris Apartment</p><p>Benoit Dereau</p></div></div></div><div class="slick-slide" data-index="4" style="outline: none; width: 770px;" tabindex="-1"><div class="slide"><div class="lazyload-placeholder"></div><div class="section-container row"><div><div class="col-md-6 col-lg-5"><div class="content first text-light"><h2 class="">Lifelike animation</h2><div>Completely customize your characters with Unreal’s Mesh and Animation editor tools, including powerful features like State Machines, Blend Spaces, Inverse Kinematics and Animation-Driven Physics. Use visual Animation Blueprints to work efficiently and preview your animations on the fly as you craft truly dynamic characters that bring your project to life.</div></div></div><div class="col-md-6 col-md-offset-0 col-lg-4 col-lg-offset-3"><div class="content second text-light hidden"><h2></h2><div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="pull-right caption"><p>Paragon</p><p>Epic Games</p></div></div></div><div class="slick-slide" data-index="5" style="outline: none; width: 770px;" tabindex="-1"><div class="slide"><div class="lazyload-placeholder"></div><div class="section-container row"><div><div class="col-md-6 col-lg-5"><div class="content text-light"><h2 class="">Templates &amp; learning resources</h2><div><p>Kickstart your work with free project templates and rich learning resources. Instantly access content across a variety of visual styles and genres while engaging with the engine and exploring entire worlds of content.</p>
</div></div></div></div></div><div class="pull-right caption"><p></p><p></p></div></div></div><div class="slick-slide" data-index="6" style="outline: none; width: 770px;" tabindex="-1"><div class="slide"><div class="lazyload-placeholder"></div><div class="section-container row"><div><div class="col-md-6 col-md-offset-6"><div class="content text-light"><h2 class="">Asset Marketplace</h2><div> The ever-expanding Unreal Engine Marketplace has thousands of high-quality assets to start or accelerate your project including Blueprints, plugins, effects, textures, animations, meshes, audio, and project starter kits. VR requires complex scenes rendered at very high framerates. Because Unreal Engine is designed for demanding applications such as AAA games, filmmaking and photoreal visualization, it meets these requirements and provides a solid foundation to build content on all VR platforms - from PC to console to mobile.</div></div></div></div><div class="row"><div class="col-md-6 no-padding"><div class="content padding-right text-left"><h3 class="">Forward renderer: push the limits</h3><div>In creating Robo Recall, Epic developed a rendering solution specific to VR. The Forward Renderer supports high-quality lighting features, Multisample Anti-Aliasing (MSAA) and instanced stereo rendering to produce crisp, detailed images at 90 FPS.</div></div></div><div class="col-md-6 no-padding"><div class="lazyload-placeholder"></div></div></div><div class="row"><div class="col-md-6 no-padding pull-right"><div class="content padding-left text-left"><h3 class="">Build VR in VR</h3><div><p>Reach out, grab and manipulate objects with the power of Unreal Engine at your fingertips. The full Unreal editor runs in VR with advanced motion controls so that you can build in a “what-you-see-is-what-you-get” environment. It’s the most robust, feature complete and capable VR development solution in the world.</p>
</div></div></div><div class="col-md-6 no-padding"><div class="lazyload-placeholder"></div></div></div><div class="row"><div class="col-md-6 no-padding"><div class="content padding-right text-left"><h3 class="margin-top">Advanced optimization</h3><div><p>Unreal is a pure C++ engine designed for high performance. Its advanced CPU/GPU profiling tools and flexible renderer equips developers to efficiently achieve quality VR experiences.</p>
</div></div></div></div></div><div class="lazyload-placeholder"></div></section><section class="section card mobile row" id="mobile"><div class="container-fluid no-padding"><div class="title invert text-center"><h4>Mobile</h4></div><div class="lazyload-placeholder"></div><div class="section-container text-center"><div class="row"><div class="col-xs-12"><div class="content"><h2 class="big">Moving mobile forward</h2><div>With the best support for Vulkan and Metal rendering APIs, Unreal enables you to deliver console quality content on mobile devices.</div></div></div></div><div class="row"><div class="col-md-8 col-md-offset-2"><div class="phone"><div class="video-phone"><div class="row phoneContainer"><div class="col-xs-10 col-xs-offset-1"><div class="video-container embed-responsive embed-responsive-16by9"><div class="lazyload-placeholder"></div></div></div></div><div class="lazyload-placeholder"></div></div><div class="lazyload-placeholder"></div></div><div class="text-center caption"><p>Lineage II: Revolution | Open World MMO</p><p>#1 in Korea generating $176,000,000 in first month</p></div></div></div><div class="row"><div class="col-xs-12"><div class="content"><h3>AAA games in the palm of your hand</h3><div><p>Increasingly powerful devices can take advantage of increasingly powerful technology. With features like dynamic shadows, physically-based rendering and custom post-processing, Unreal powers the most cutting-edge gaming experiences on mobile.</p>
